## Football effect

Jensen played three offensive snaps and one kicking-game snap in Henne's mixed group before the injury was logged, with no catch or target; Marcedes Lewis took his place in Wilson's, Bray's and Shaw's tight-end groups for the rest of the game, the kernel's replacement under the frozen chart. The hold is the medical staff's and no football finding attaches to it. He missed the August 23 review and install, the August 25 and 26 padded practices and the August 27 walkthrough, and was reassessed August 24 with no change; the August 28 game against Atlanta falls on his projected return date. Stone's frozen Atlanta plan does not build around a player who was unavailable for the week's work, so he is inactive on the frozen game depth chart and outside the rotation; a release on August 28, if the independent process communicates it, is recorded on the day and restores no role ([Game_04 inputs](../../../04_Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Preseason_Games/Game_04/README.md)). Through August 27: five elapsed days, three practices and a walkthrough missed, no game missed yet. His game-2 work (the 29-yard third-and-1 catch and a coverage tackle) and his camp blocking evidence stand as recorded; the TE3 comparison with Hoskins received nothing from his side in this game. A release does not automatically restore a role, and no role was set.
